attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Mark and send pet
macros.desc: Mark your target and send your pet at it with one button.
macros.needs: Hunter's Mark learned; living pet for the pet command
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Marca do Caçador
/petattack
/cast Marca do Caçador

macros.title: Mend your pet
macros.desc: Heal your pet while keeping your enemy selected.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Curar Ajudante
/cast [@pet,exists,nodead] Curar Ajudante

macros.title: Send your pet at your mouseover
macros.desc: Your pet attacks the enemy under your mouse without changing your target; with nothing hovered it goes for your target.
macros.codePt: /petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][]

macros.title: Pet attack, Shift to recall
macros.desc: Send your pet at your target. Hold Shift to make it passive and bring it back; recalling never sends another attack command in the same press.
macros.codePt:
/petattack [nomod:shift,harm,nodead]
/petpassive [mod:shift]
/petfollow [mod:shift]

macros.title: Call, revive or mend your pet
macros.desc: Mends a healthy pet, calls it if it isn't out and revives it if it's dead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [@pet,dead][mod:shift] Revive Pet; [nopet] Call Pet; Mend Pet

keys.text: Mend, call or revive, whichever your pet needs

macros.needs: Call Pet, Revive Pet and Mend Pet learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [@pet,dead][mod:shift] Reviver Ajudante; [nopet] Chamar Ajudante; Curar Ajudante

macros.title: Feed your pet outside combat
macros.desc: Casts Feed Pet and hands over the food, only when your pet is out and you're out of combat.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Feed Pet
/cast [pet,nocombat] Feed Pet
/use [pet,nocombat] Chunk of Boar Meat
macros.needs: Food in your bags that your pet eats; swap in its name for Chunk of Boar Meat
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Alimentar Ajudante
/cast [pet,nocombat] Alimentar Ajudante
/use [pet,nocombat] Chunk of Boar Meat

macros.title: Aspect of the Hawk after Cheetah
macros.desc: Drops Aspect of the Cheetah and puts Hawk on, without toggling Hawk off if it's already up.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Aspect of the Hawk
/cancelaura Aspect of the Cheetah
/cast !Aspect of the Hawk
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Aspecto do Falcão
/cancelaura Aspecto do Guepardo
/cast !Aspecto do Falcão

macros.title: Cheetah, or Pack on right-click
macros.desc: Left-click for Aspect of the Cheetah and right-click for Aspect of the Pack when the group needs to move.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Aspect of the Cheetah
/cast [button:2] !Aspect of the Pack; !Aspect of the Cheetah
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Aspecto do Guepardo
/cast [button:2] !Aspecto da Matilha; !Aspecto do Guepardo

macros.title: Tracking on one button
macros.desc: Switch tracking with modifier keys instead of opening the spellbook.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Track Beasts; [mod:ctrl] Track Undead; [mod:alt] Track Hidden; Track Humanoids
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Rastrear Feras; [mod:ctrl] Rastrear Mortos-vivos; [mod:alt] Rastrear Furtivos; Rastrear Humanoides

macros.title: Feign Death that lets combat drop
macros.desc: Tells your pet to stand down and stops your shooting first, then feigns only if you're in combat.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fingir de Morto
/petpassive
/petfollow
/stopattack
/stopcasting
/cast [combat] Fingir de Morto

macros.title: Cancel Cheetah or Pack
macros.desc: Remove either running aspect immediately without spending mana on another aspect. Useful before incoming damage can daze you or your group.
macros.code:
/cancelaura Aspect of the Cheetah
/cancelaura Aspect of the Pack
macros.codePt:
/cancelaura Aspecto do Guepardo
/cancelaura Aspecto da Matilha

macros.title: Chain Eagle Eye viewpoints
macros.desc: Open Eagle Eye's targeting circle without cancelling the existing viewpoint. Choose the next spot with a click; movement or Escape ends scouting.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Olho de Águia
/cast !Olho de Águia

macros.title: Intimidation and pet attack
macros.desc: Send your pet; its next successful attack stuns the enemy.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Intimidação
/petattack
/cast Intimidação

macros.title: Call your pet back
macros.desc: Stop its attack and bring it back before it pulls more enemies.
macros.codePt:
/petpassive
/petfollow

macros.title: Arcane Shot or Summon Hawk
macros.desc: Fires Arcane Shot, or sends a hawk at your target or mouseover; both use one cooldown, so you pick one per window.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Summon Hawk; [mod:shift] Summon Hawk; Arcane Shot
/cast !Auto Shot
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Evocar Falcão; [mod:shift] Evocar Falcão; Tiro Arcano
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Bestial Wrath with a trinket
macros.desc: Sends your pet in, uses the trinket in your first slot and rages your pet.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bestial Wrath
/petattack
/use 13
/cast [mod:shift] Rapid Fire
/cast Bestial Wrath

keys.text: Pet attack, first trinket, Bestial Wrath

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ira Bestial
/petattack
/use 13
/cast [mod:shift] Tiro Rápido
/cast Ira Bestial

macros.title: Growl on when solo, off in a group
macros.desc: Sets your pet's Growl autocast for the situation: on when you're alone, off in a party or raid.
macros.codePt:
/petautocastoff [group] Growl
/petautocaston [nogroup] Growl

macros.title: Pet stance on one key
macros.desc: Change your pet's stance without opening the pet bar.
macros.codePt:
/petdefensive [nomod]
/petpassive [mod:shift]
/petaggressive [mod:ctrl]

macros.title: Beast Lore, then Tame Beast
macros.desc: The first press reads the beast's diet and damage, the second starts taming; a new target starts over.
macros.needs: Beast Lore (level 24) and Tame Beast learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target Tradição das Feras, Domar Fera

macros.title: Tranquilizing Shot on your mouseover
macros.desc: Removes a Frenzy effect from the enemy creature under your mouse, or from your target if you aren't hovering one.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Tranquilizante
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Tiro Tranquilizante

macros.title: Park your pet and scout
macros.desc: Tells your pet to stay, then lets you see through its eyes for 2 minutes.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Eyes of the Beast
/petstay
/cast Eyes of the Beast
macros.needs: Eyes of the Beast learned (level 14); living pet
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Olhos da Fera
/petstay
/cast Olhos da Fera

macros.title: Concussive Shot pull with your pet
macros.desc: Slows the enemy, sends your pet in and keeps Auto Shot running.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro de Concussão
/petattack
/cast Tiro de Concussão
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Scare Beast on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Scares a beast for up to 10 seconds; hold Shift to scare the beast under your mouse.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Scare Beast
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Scare Beast; Scare Beast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Assustar Fera
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Assustar Fera; Assustar Fera

macros.title: Send your pet with Dash, Dive or Charge
macros.desc: Send your pet at a hostile mouseover or your target, then request its movement ability. The pet uses whichever listed ability it has learned.
macros.needs: A living pet trained in Dash, Dive or Charge; pet Focus and cooldowns still apply
macros.codePt:
/petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead]
/cast [@pettarget,harm,nodead] Investida
/cast Arremetida
/cast Mergulho

macros.title: Start Auto Shot
macros.desc: Find an enemy if you have no valid target, then start shooting.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Automático
/targetenemy [noexists][dead][help]
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Aimed Shot and pet attack
macros.desc: Send your pet when you begin the Aimed Shot cast.
macros.needs: Aimed Shot learned at 20; living pet for the pet command
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Certo
/petattack
/cast Tiro Certo

macros.title: Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot on one key
macros.desc: Aimed Shot and Multi-Shot share a 6 second cooldown in Forever, so this gives you one or the other each window.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Tiro Múltiplo; [mod:ctrl,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Tiro Múltiplo; Tiro Certo
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Sniper Shot and Auto Shot
macros.desc: Cast Sniper Shot at your target or Shift-mouseover and keep Auto Shot on. The October 1 update sets a 45-yard range and +10 yards for your next three Shots.
macros.needs: Sniper Shot talent (level 40); target beyond the minimum range. The saved build-70009 tooltip showed 8–35 yards.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro de Franco-atirador
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Tiro de Franco-atirador
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Rapid Fire with both trinkets
macros.desc: Uses both trinkets and Rapid Fire together, and makes sure Auto Shot is running.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Rápido
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Tiro Rápido
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Drop or call your pet for Lone Wolf
macros.desc: Calls your pet or dismisses it so you can fight petless for Lone Wolf's 20% damage; dismissing costs the pet 50 happiness.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Revive Pet; [nopet] Call Pet; Dismiss Pet

keys.text: Call your pet if it's away, dismiss it if it's out

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Reviver Ajudante; [nopet] Chamar Ajudante; Dispensar Ajudante

macros.title: Serpent Sting on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Puts Serpent Sting on your target, or on the enemy under your mouse with Shift, and keeps Auto Shot on.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Serpent Sting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Serpent Sting; Serpent Sting
/cast !Auto Shot
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Picada de Serpente
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Picada de Serpente; Picada de Serpente
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Distracting Shot on your mouseover
macros.desc: Pull a loose enemy off a groupmate by hovering it, or hit your target if nothing is hovered.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Distrativo
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Tiro Distrativo

macros.title: Mark, Serpent Sting, Arcane Shot opener
macros.desc: Press up to three times for mark, sting and Arcane Shot while your pet attacks and Auto Shot stays on; a new target or 8 seconds resets it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/targetenemy [noexists][dead][help]
/castsequence reset=target/8 Hunter's Mark, Serpent Sting, Arcane Shot
/petattack
/cast !Auto Shot
macros.needs: Hunter's Mark, Serpent Sting and Arcane Shot learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/targetenemy [noexists][dead][help]
/castsequence reset=target/8 Marca do Caçador, Picada de Serpente, Tiro Arcano
/petattack
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Back to shooting after melee
macros.desc: Stops your melee swings, finds an enemy if you lost your target and turns Auto Shot back on. The Auto Attack/Auto Shot option added on 15 October can make this switch for you.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Automático
/stopattack
/targetenemy [noexists][dead][help]
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Lacerate and melee attack
macros.desc: Puts Lacerate's 21 second bleed on your target and keeps your melee swings going.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lacerar
/startattack
/cast Lacerar

macros.title: Strider Kick
macros.desc: Kick in melee and run 30% faster for 3 seconds; it has an 8 second cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Chute de Moa
/startattack
/cast Chute de Moa

macros.title: Raptor Strike with Mongoose Bite
macros.desc: Queues Raptor Strike, starts your swings and casts Mongoose Bite when it's usable; Shift casts Counterattack after a parry instead.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast Golpe do Raptor
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Contra-ataque; Mordida de Mangusto

macros.title: Mark it for Expose Prey
macros.desc: Marks your target so Expose Prey can light up Mongoose Bite, sends your pet and starts your swings once you're in range.
macros.needs: Expose Prey talent; Hunter's Mark learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Marca do Caçador
/petattack
/startattack
/cast Marca do Caçador

macros.title: Wing Clip and Raptor Strike
macros.desc: Slows your target in melee, queues Raptor Strike and keeps your swings going.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Wing Clip
/startattack
/cast Raptor Strike
/cast Wing Clip
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cortar Asas
/startattack
/cast Golpe do Raptor
/cast Cortar Asas

macros.title: Immolation or Explosive Trap
macros.desc: Drop Immolation Trap, or Explosive Trap with Shift, at your feet during combat. Since 2 November every trap shares one 30 sec cooldown.
macros.needs: Immolation Trap; Explosive Trap (level 34) for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Armadilha Explosiva; Armadilha Imolante

macros.title: Aspects for melee
macros.desc: Puts on Monkey for dodge or Beast for melee attack power on one key, with Hawk and Cheetah on the other modifiers.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] !Aspect of the Beast; [mod:ctrl] !Aspect of the Hawk; [mod:alt] !Aspect of the Cheetah; !Aspect of the Monkey
macros.needs: Aspect of the Beast (level 30); Aspect of the Cheetah (level 20) for Alt
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] !Aspecto da Fera; [mod:ctrl] !Aspecto do Falcão; [mod:alt] !Aspecto do Guepardo; !Aspecto do Macaco

macros.title: Deterrence with Aspect of the Monkey
macros.desc: Pops Deterrence and adds Monkey's dodge on top when enemies are on you in melee.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Coibição
/cast Coibição
/cast !Aspecto do Macaco

macros.title: Freezing Trap or Frost Trap
macros.desc: Drops Freezing Trap after calling off your pet and your shots, or Frost Trap with Shift while you keep fighting. Traps work during combat at your feet, and every trap shares one 30 sec cooldown.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Frost Trap; Freezing Trap
/stopcasting
/stopattack [nomod]
/petstay [nomod,@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [nomod,@pettarget,harm]
/cast [mod:shift] Frost Trap; Freezing Trap

keys.text: Freezing Trap, pet and shots stopped

macros.needs: Freezing Trap learned; Frost Trap (level 28) for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Armadilha Gélida; Armadilha Congelante
/stopcasting
/stopattack [nomod]
/petstay [nomod,@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [nomod,@pettarget,harm]
/cast [mod:shift] Armadilha Gélida; Armadilha Congelante

macros.title: Trap, then Feign Death
macros.desc: Drops a trap and feigns in the same press so chasers run over it; your pet stands down first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Frost Trap; Freezing Trap
/petpassive
/petfollow
/stopattack
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Frost Trap; Freezing Trap
/cast [combat] Feign Death
macros.needs: Freezing Trap learned; Feign Death (level 30); Frost Trap (level 28) for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Armadilha Gélida; Armadilha Congelante
/petpassive
/petfollow
/stopattack
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Armadilha Gélida; Armadilha Congelante
/cast [combat] Fingir de Morto

macros.title: Concussive Shot or Wing Clip
macros.desc: Slows your target at range with Concussive Shot, your mouseover with Shift, or with Wing Clip in melee on Ctrl.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Concussive Shot
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Concussive Shot; [mod:ctrl] Wing Clip; Concussive Shot
macros.needs: Concussive Shot and Wing Clip learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro de Concussão
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Tiro de Concussão; [mod:ctrl] Cortar Asas; Tiro de Concussão

macros.title: Black Arrow on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Slows the enemy by 70% and drains its mana; Shift sends it at your mouseover.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Flecha Negra
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Flecha Negra

macros.title: Viper Sting on healers and casters
macros.desc: Drains mana from your target, or your mouseover with Shift; Ctrl uses Scorpid Sting, which lowers their chance to hit in Forever.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Viper Sting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Viper Sting; [mod:ctrl] Scorpid Sting; Viper Sting
macros.needs: Viper Sting (level 36); Scorpid Sting for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Picada de Víbora
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Picada de Víbora; [mod:ctrl] Picada de Escorpídeo; Picada de Víbora

macros.title: Hunter's Mark on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Marks the enemy you hover with Shift; you can always see a marked target, even if it stealths.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Marca do Caçador
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Marca do Caçador

macros.title: Pet control on one key
macros.desc: Send your pet at your target or mouseover, call it back or park it, all on one key.
macros.codePt:
/petattack [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nomod]
/petpassive [mod:ctrl]
/petfollow [mod:ctrl]
/petstay [mod:alt]

macros.title: Flare or Enchanted Flare
macros.desc: Puts a Flare down where you click to expose hidden enemies; Shift uses Enchanted Flare, which also holds off magical darkness.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Sinalizador Encantado; Sinalizador

macros.title: Aspect swap on modifier keys
macros.desc: Hawk by default, dropping Cheetah first, with Cheetah, Monkey and Pack on modifier keys for running or defending.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cancelaura [nomod] Aspect of the Cheetah
/cast [mod:shift] !Aspect of the Cheetah; [mod:ctrl] !Aspect of the Monkey; [mod:alt] !Aspect of the Pack; !Aspect of the Hawk
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cancelaura [nomod] Aspecto do Guepardo
/cast [mod:shift] !Aspecto do Guepardo; [mod:ctrl] !Aspecto do Macaco; [mod:alt] !Aspecto da Matilha; !Aspecto do Falcão

macros.title: Scare Beast with your shots and pet called off
macros.desc: Fears an enemy Hunter's pet or a Druid in animal form after stopping your shots and pulling your pet back, so nothing of yours breaks it. Shift aims at your mouseover.
macros.needs: Scare Beast learned. Druid forms count as Beasts in Classic; not confirmed in Forever yet
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Assustar Fera
/stopcasting
/stopattack
/petfollow [@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Assustar Fera

macros.title: Shadowmeld with your pet tucked in
macros.desc: Stops your shots, brings your pet back on passive, has a cat Prowl and melds you. Forever lets you Shadowmeld in combat on a 2 min cooldown.
macros.needs: Night Elf; a cat with Prowl, since any other pet standing next to you gives you away
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fusão Sombria
/stopcasting
/stopattack
/petpassive
/petfollow
/cast !Espreitar
/cast !Fusão Sombria

macros.title: Bestial Wrath and Intimidation
macros.desc: Sends your pet in, rages it and stuns the target with Intimidation, or your mouseover with Shift.

keys.text: Pet attack, Bestial Wrath and Intimidation on your target

macros.needs: Intimidation and Bestial Wrath talents; living pet
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Intimidação
/petattack [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][]
/cast Ira Bestial
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Intimidação

macros.title: Intimidation on your pet's target
macros.desc: Readies the stun on whatever your pet is already biting, say a healer, without pulling it off or changing your own target. With no pet target it uses yours.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Intimidação
/cast [@pettarget,harm,nodead][] Intimidação

macros.title: Pet on a teammate's target
macros.desc: Hover or target a teammate and your pet goes for whatever they have targeted, with Dash or Dive. Shift also queues Intimidation on that enemy.

keys.text: Pet attacks your teammate's target, with Dash or Dive
The same, plus Intimidation on that enemy

macros.needs: Living pet; Dash or Dive for the speed; Intimidation talent for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Intimidação
/petattack [@mouseovertarget,harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead]
/cast Arremetida
/cast Mergulho
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseovertarget,harm,nodead][mod:shift,@targettarget,harm,nodead] Intimidação

macros.title: Disarm with your bird of prey
macros.desc: Your bird of prey disarms whatever it is fighting for 3 sec. Shift sends it at your mouseover first; it has to be in melee range, so press again once it gets there.

keys.text: Mine! on your pet's target, or yours
Pet attacks your mouseover and uses Mine! on it

macros.needs: A bird of prey pet (Forever's renamed Owl family) that knows Mine!
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Peguei!
/petattack [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][@pettarget,harm,nodead][] Peguei!

macros.title: Pull your pet out and mend it
macros.desc: Calls a focused pet back on passive with Dash or Dive and casts Mend Pet on it. With Improved Mend Pet each heal can also clear a debuff. Send it back in when it's safe.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mend Pet
/petpassive
/petfollow
/cast Dash
/cast Dive
/cast [@pet,exists,nodead] Mend Pet
macros.needs: Mend Pet learned; Improved Mend Pet talent for the cleanse
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Curar Ajudante
/petpassive
/petfollow
/cast Arremetida
/cast Mergulho
/cast [@pet,exists,nodead] Curar Ajudante

macros.title: Cat Prowl, then ambush with Intimidation
macros.desc: Puts your cat in Prowl on passive. Shift sends it from stealth with Intimidation queued, so the first hit stuns and gets Forever's 100% extra crit chance.

keys.text: Cat attacks your mouseover or target, Intimidation queued

macros.needs: A cat with Prowl (pet level 30); Intimidation talent for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petpassive [nomod]
/cast [nomod] !Espreitar
/petattack [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Intimidação

macros.title: Pet and a hawk on your mouseover
macros.desc: Sends your pet and a hawk at the enemy under your mouse, often a healer, while you keep shooting your own target. Summon Hawk shares a cooldown with Arcane Shot.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Evocar Falcão
/petattack [@mouseover,harm,nodead][]
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Evocar Falcão

macros.title: Bestial Wrath with your racial
macros.desc: Sends your pet and fires Bestial Wrath with Blood Fury, Berserking or Elune's Light, whichever your race has. The lines your race can't use do nothing.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bestial Wrath
/petattack
/cast Blood Fury
/cast Berserking
/cast Elune's Light
/cast Bestial Wrath
macros.needs: Bestial Wrath talent; Orc, Troll or Night Elf for the racial
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ira Bestial
/petattack
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast Berserk
/cast Luz de Eluna
/cast Ira Bestial

macros.title: Scatter Shot with your pet called off
macros.desc: Sends your pet away so it can't break the disorient, then Scatters your target, or your mouseover with Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Scatter Shot
/petstay [@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Scatter Shot; Scatter Shot
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro de Dispersão
/petstay [@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Tiro de Dispersão; Tiro de Dispersão

macros.title: Scatter Shot, then Freezing Trap
macros.desc: Press once to Scatter Shot and again to drop Freezing Trap under the enemy at your feet; it resets after 6 seconds.
macros.needs: Scatter Shot talent; Freezing Trap learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/castsequence reset=6 Tiro de Dispersão, Armadilha Congelante

macros.title: Scatter Shot, then Aimed Shot
macros.desc: Scatters your target with your pet held back, then the next press hard-casts Aimed Shot. Its 2 sec cast fits inside the 4 sec disorient. A new target or 6 sec starts over.
macros.needs: Scatter Shot talent; Aimed Shot learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petstay [@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/castsequence reset=target/6 Tiro de Dispersão, Tiro Certo

macros.title: Scatter Shot, then Concussive Shot
macros.desc: Scatters your target with your pet held back. Back off and press again as it wears off to slow them; Improved Concussive Shot can turn that into a stun.
macros.needs: Scatter Shot talent; Improved Concussive Shot for the stun chance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petstay [@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/castsequence reset=target/10 Tiro de Dispersão, Tiro de Concussão

macros.title: Sniper Shot opener from long range
macros.desc: Opens with Sniper Shot from up to 45 yards, then Aimed Shot and Arcane Shot on the next presses while its extra 10 yards last. A new target or 10 sec starts over.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/10 Sniper Shot, Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/10 Tiro de Franco-atirador, Tiro Certo, Tiro Arcano

macros.title: Sniper Shot, or cancel it for Scatter Shot
macros.desc: Casts Sniper Shot. If someone closes in while you're casting, Shift stops the cast, holds your pet back and Scatters your target.

keys.text: Stop casting and Scatter Shot your target

macros.needs: Sniper Shot (level 40) and Scatter Shot talents
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting [mod:shift]
/petstay [mod:shift,@pettarget,harm]
/petpassive [mod:shift,@pettarget,harm]
/cast [mod:shift] Tiro de Dispersão; Tiro de Franco-atirador

macros.title: Aimed Shot, with Rapid Fire on Shift
macros.desc: Casts Aimed Shot. Hold Shift on your burst window to also use your first trinket and Rapid Fire, which are both off the global cooldown.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Aimed Shot
/use [mod:shift] 13
/cast [mod:shift] Rapid Fire
/cast Aimed Shot

keys.text: First trinket, Rapid Fire and Aimed Shot

macros.needs: Aimed Shot learned; Rapid Fire (level 26) for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Tiro Certo
/use [mod:shift] 13
/cast [mod:shift] Tiro Rápido
/cast Tiro Certo

macros.title: Concussive Shot, then Arcane Shot
macros.desc: Slows a chaser, then the next press fires Arcane Shot, both instant so you can shoot while you kite. Auto Shot stays on. A new target or 12 sec starts over.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/12 Concussive Shot, Arcane Shot
/cast !Auto Shot
macros.needs: Concussive Shot and Arcane Shot learned; Improved Concussive Shot adds a stun chance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/12 Tiro de Concussão, Tiro Arcano
/cast !Tiro Automático

macros.title: Strider Kick on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Kicks your target and starts your swings, or kicks the enemy under your mouse with Shift, and speeds you up either way.

keys.text: Strider Kick at your target and start swinging

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Chute de Moa
/startattack [nomod]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Chute de Moa

macros.title: Wing Clip with melee reactions
macros.desc: Queues Raptor Strike and slows your target with Wing Clip, or answers a parry with Counterattack (Shift) or a dodge with Mongoose Bite (Ctrl).
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/startattack
/cast Raptor Strike
/cast [mod:shift] Counterattack; [mod:ctrl] Mongoose Bite; Wing Clip
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/startattack
/cast Golpe do Raptor
/cast [mod:shift] Contra-ataque; [mod:ctrl] Mordida de Mangusto; Cortar Asas

macros.title: Counterattack on mouseover, Deterrence on Shift
macros.desc: Once Counterattack lights up after a parry, roots the enemy under your mouse, or your target, for 5 sec. Shift pops Deterrence first for 25% more parry.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contra-ataque
/cast [mod:shift] Coibição
/startattack
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Contra-ataque

macros.title: Wing Clip your mouseover in melee
macros.desc: Keeps swinging at your target with Raptor Strike queued and Wing Clips the second melee under your mouse. Improved Wing Clip gives each clip a chance to root.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Wing Clip
/startattack
/cast Raptor Strike
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Wing Clip
macros.needs: Wing Clip learned; Improved Wing Clip talent for the root chance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cortar Asas
/startattack
/cast Golpe do Raptor
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Cortar Asas

macros.title: Wing Clip, then Strider Kick
macros.desc: Slows your target by 60%, then the next press Strider Kicks for 30% run speed, to get back to range or to keep up with a runner. Resets after 8 sec.
macros.needs: Strider Kick talent; Wing Clip learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=8 Cortar Asas, Chute de Moa

macros.title: Strider Kick, then Freezing Trap
macros.desc: Kick the melee on you and run with the speed boost, then press again to drop Freezing Trap in their path. Your pet comes back so it won't break the ice.
macros.needs: Strider Kick talent; Freezing Trap learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/petfollow [@pettarget,harm]
/castsequence reset=8 Chute de Moa, Armadilha Congelante

macros.title: Counterattack, then Freezing Trap
macros.desc: Roots them for 5 sec once Counterattack lights up. Step back and press again to drop Freezing Trap between you, so they walk into it when the root ends.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/petpassive [@pettarget,harm]
/petfollow [@pettarget,harm]
/castsequence reset=8 Contra-ataque, Armadilha Congelante

macros.title: Lacerate on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Puts the 21 sec bleed on your target, or on the rogue under your mouse, so its ticks can break them out of a Vanish.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lacerar
/startattack
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Lacerar

/use 14
